paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 9a, addressing Rav Papa as “Master”; Hyman infers from the passage that he was Rav Papa’s student.[^1]

notes.text: The actual William Davidson Bava Batra 9a paragraph has Rav Sama son of Rav Yeiva addressing Rav Papa as “Master.” This supports the local Rav Papa expansion of ר״פ. The claim of discipleship remains Hyman’s inference rather than a newly established teacher relationship, and no additional legal content is imported.
